name: VSN F-100 Super Sabre
summary: VSN team's free F-100 Super Sabre with EFM for DCS World.
description:
Free VSN mod adding the North American F-100 Super Sabre with an EFM and Lua systems by PeeJott (3D model data donated by Squeak). Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)
